reason: A browser-side UI enhancement plugin that customizes assistant Markdown rendering and presents chain-of-thought content in a draggable floating window, with settings persisted in localStorage.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供可配置的 Markdown 彩色高亮，并支持将思维链显示在可拖拽的悬浮窗口中。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds configurable Markdown color highlighting and displays chain-of-thought content in a draggable floating window.

capabilities: customizes Markdown colors and styling in assistant content
separates chain-of-thought display into a draggable floating window
persists plugin settings in browser localStorage
